configuration_review.evidence: Source-level expected path removal only. CI must collect generated AND installed configuration.h defines, structured configdata disabled map, runtime disabled listings, negative CMS/QUIC/SIV registration checks, positive native group/signature/AES-GCM capability, static linkage and real mTLS. applicability.CVE-2026-88822: 4.1.0 affected upstream: QUIC automated peer detection leaks stack data. For the five exact configurations above, no-quic is expected to exclude the QUIC implementation (OPENSSL_NO_QUIC), not patch it. Runtime/header/linkage and mTLS evidence pending; CI still blocks. Remaining 3.6.5 is unsupported/unanalysed.
applicability.CVE-2026-95691: 4.1.0 affected upstream: retransmitted QUIC CRYPTO client UAF. Same no-quic removal expectation for the five exact configurations; no whole-program or produced-binary proof yet. CI still blocks.
applicability.CVE-2026-88823: 4.1.0 affected upstream: AES-GCM-SIV fragmented/zero-length AAD authentication error. no-siv controls both SIV and GCM-SIV implementation sources and default-provider registration. Require OPENSSL_NO_SIV plus no AES-*-SIV/AES-*-GCM-SIV runtime registration; ordinary AES-GCM retained. Evidence pending; CI still blocks.
applicability.CVE-2026-95692: 4.1.0 affected upstream: AES-GCM-SIV short/long IV handling. Same no-siv removal expectation, not an AES-GCM TLS vulnerability or a patch. Evidence pending; CI still blocks.
applicability.CVE-2026-107496: CMS_encrypt/CMS_encrypt_ex with attacker-controlled EC order=1 recipient. Advisory limits 4.x exposure to enable-ec_explicit_curves; these configurations do not enable it and additionally use no-cms. Require OPENSSL_NO_CMS and OPENSSL_NO_EC_EXPLICIT_CURVES and absent CMS CLI registration. TLS/QUIC do not use the CMS path, but that fact alone is not a waiver. Evidence pending; CI still blocks.
